blocks.text: INQUIRER.net / Updated as of: 08:49 AM October 30, 2026

MANILA, Philippines — Preparations for Undas 2026 are in place across the country, with authorities ready to manage the influx of cemetery visitors and travelers heading to their home provinces for All Saints’ Day and All Souls’ Day.
Follow our live updates for the latest on cemetery preparations, traffic conditions, passenger volume, public transport, weather advisories, and safety measures as the country observes Undas.
